notes:
Discovered candidates from /query-index.json (708-row EDS content index) under /us/c/sale/*, verified counts via the public GraphQL endpoint (products(filter:{category_url_path:{eq:"<path>"}}){total_count}), and read each page's SSR <title>/<meta description> (the EDS SPA body is client-rendered but title/meta ship server-side) to apply the Clearance-vs-Sale test. EXCLUDED per that test: /us/c/sale itself (417/440/917-scale hub, meta 'Designer Lighting Sale: Up to 70% Off... while limited inventory remains' - a generic umbrella Sale page that rolls up every seasonal campaign, not itself a clearance/outlet taxonomy node); and all its seasonal/calendar-tied children with no permanence signal - black-friday, cyber-week, 2024-cyber-week, early-black-friday, memorial-day-sale, labor-day-sale, presidents-day-sale, independence-day-sale, fall-sale, spring-event, summer-event, winter-event, fan-event, design-event (14 nodes, all temporary promotional campaigns per the brief's exclusion rule). Also excluded /us/c/dallas-market-specials/{ceiling,floor,outdoor,table,wall} - all 5 return product_count=0 (empty placeholder nodes from a past trade-show event). INCLUDED as genuine Clearance: Last Call (meta: 'Save up to 70% off Last Call styles! Prices as marked. All sales final.' - textbook permanent-markdown/clearance language, not a calendar campaign) and Open Box with its 5 live per-room children (meta: 'Save on like-new Open Box lighting... with full warranty coverage and limited quantities available while inventory lasts' - an ongoing outlet-style program, not a seasonal event). Last Look is included but flagged: its own meta describes it as 'A Trade Exclusive program offering an additional 50% off current Trade pricing on select items as they prepare to move to Last Call' - i.e. a trade-only pre-clearance staging list feeding INTO Last Call, not itself the final public clearance listing (catalog data is publicly queryable via GraphQL without login; only trade purchase eligibility may be gated). No trade/account login was required to read any of this project's catalog data.

[POLICY UPDATE 2026-09-11 PASS 3] Removed 6 Open Box row(s) per user directive. Also: site restructured since original extraction (old /us/c/sale/* URLs all 404 now). Dropped 'Last Look' entirely (its new-site path /sale/last-look/ also 404s and the site's own current /sale/ hub copy no longer mentions 'Last Look' anywhere, only 'Last Call and Open Box' -- genuinely discontinued, not just a broken link). Corrected 'Last Call' to its new working URL https://www.visualcomfort.com/sale/last-call/ (confirmed 200 OK, H1 'Last Call') but nulled its qty and flagged for manual review since the new page is a client-rendered SPA with no server-rendered count to verify the old 417 figure against.
